event.title: Australian MP Helen Haines Critically Injured in Apparent Vehicle Attack
event.canonical_title: Australian MP Helen Haines Critically Injured in Apparent Vehicle Attack
event.summary: Independent MP Helen Haines is in critical condition after being struck by a vehicle outside her office in Wangaratta, Victoria. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese stated that the incident appears to be a deliberate attack, and a man has been arrested in connection with the event. This incident has raised concerns about the safety of politicians in Australia.

timeline.title: Australian MP Helen Haines Suffers Leg Amputation After Vehicle Attack, Suspect Charged
timeline.summary: Australian MP Helen Haines remains in critical condition after being struck by a vehicle outside her office in Wangaratta. The incident, described as a targeted attack, resulted in Haines undergoing a leg amputation. A man has been charged with three offenses related to the incident, including dangerous driving causing serious injury. The suspect's family claims to have known Haines for over 20 years.
key_facts: Helen Haines was hit by a vehicle outside her office.
She underwent a leg amputation and is in critical condition.
A man has been charged with three offenses related to the attack.
